instruction: Back-Annotation of Footprint Changes The files design.kicad_sch and design.kicad_pcb are a matched KiCad 10.0.2 schematic and board. For this task, start KiCad with `/usr/bin/kicad`; the board and schematic editors are also available directly at `/usr/bin/pcbnew` and `/usr/bin/eeschema`. Some components were changed on the board side after the schematic was last annotated, and the schematic still carries the older footprint assignments for those parts. Back-annotate the schematic so every component's Footprint field matches the footprint used in the board. Write the updated schematic as /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_sch. Requirements: 1. For every refdes, the Footprint property in the output schematic must exactly match the footprint name used for that component in design.kicad_pcb. 2. Components whose footprints were not changed in the board must retain their original Footprint field (no spurious changes). 3. The symbol count, all reference designators, all Value fields, and all other properties must remain unchanged. 4. No Footprint field may be empty. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_sch.
